entities.name: Callinicus of Heliopolis
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Callinicus of Heliopolis was a Byzantine architect and alchemist of Jewish or Egyptian origin. He is credited with the invention of Greek fire, the premodern precedent of the flamethrower.
